sources_tried: Seed file san-francisco.json: worked. Plausible Maps entries opened. Partition Specialties Inc (psi3g.com) does operable walls and access floors, not toilet partitions, so it was excluded. Service Metal Products' site came back empty. Division General Building is residential remodeling, so it was excluded.
Scranton Products where-to-buy: worked, but it lists only a regional rep (John McKeon, CA and the western states) and no local dealers or installers.
Bradley find-a-rep: page loaded empty, no data.
ASI/Global/Accurate, Hadrian, Metpar, General Partitions, Ampco locators: not tried (web search cap and time).

The Blue Book (thebluebook.com iProView pages): 403 Forbidden on fetch; only search snippets were seen (Delta Specialties, Consolidated Partitions, Partition Specialties Novato, American Sheet Metal Partition Co).
BuildingConnected / Procore public profiles: not reached.

WebSearch: 8 of 8 used. Queries: SF toilet partition installation; Division 10 East Bay; Blue Book SF; East Bay installers; furnish-and-install Peninsula/Marin; Delta Specialties; Yelp; Hayward/Fremont/Concord subcontractors. Results were dominated by onepointpartitions.com, a national online supplier with a San Leandro terminal; its fetch returned 403 and it appears supply-only, so it was excluded.
Yelp and BBB: no listings surfaced in search.

candidates.name: Rebarber Enterprises
candidates.partition_evidence: Division 10 subcontractor that specializes in toilet compartments. All six listed projects include toilet compartments (Chase Arena and Levi's Stadium Bobrick phenolic, Merck SSF Hadrian stainless, 181 Fremont Accurate, Nvidia Privada).
red_flags: Works for large general contractors on big projects, so small jobs may not suit them
The seed said Hayward, but the contact page points to San Francisco and gives no address
candidates.reason: A San Francisco Division 10 subcontractor with toilet compartments on every named commercial project. It is the best-documented installer on the list.

license.name: Rebarber Enterprises
license.registry: California CSLB Check a License (cslb.ca.gov). San Francisco DBI registration uses the CSLB license.
license.license_type: California contractor license (expected C-61/D-34 Prefabricated Equipment for toilet partitions); not confirmed
license.note: The CSLB lookup needs a reCAPTCHA form postback, so no official record could be read. The company site (rebarber.net, rebarber.net/contact-us/) says 'The Bay Area's #1 Division 10 Subcontractor' and gives phone 415-533-4465, but shows no license number and no address. A search snippet from an aggregator (prelien.co/contractor/rebarber-enterprises-872996) gives CSLB #872996, Hayward, status clear, expiring 2028-02-29. I did not open that page, it is not official, and it doesn't show classifications. Confirm #872996 on CSLB by hand.

candidates.name: Magnum Drywall
candidates.partition_evidence: Its Division 10 page says it works with clients to specify and install toilet partitions. Malwarebytes in Santa Clara is a named project that includes toilet partitions.
red_flags: Union drywall contractor where Division 10 is one of five divisions, so it is geared to general contractor bid work
San Jose is about 40+ miles from the SF center, but under 30 from Hayward and Fremont
candidates.reason: A union commercial subcontractor that installs toilet partitions, with a named Santa Clara project. It is based at the south edge of the Bay Area.

license.name: Magnum Drywall
license.note: The company site states 'CA License: #614200' and lists a San Jose office with phone (408) 600-0422. The CSLB detail page for 614200 needs a reCAPTCHA, so I couldn't confirm the status or whether it includes C-61/D-34. Confirm on CSLB by hand.

candidates.name: TPH Supply
candidates.partition_evidence: States experience installing commercial bathroom partitions and offers local installation or repair in the San Francisco Bay Area.
red_flags: Base city not given (site says only 'Based in the USA')
Mainly an online seller of partition hardware and parts that ships nationwide, so it is a buy-around risk
No projects or photos of installs
candidates.reason: Offers partition installation and repair in the Bay Area and has a 650 number. It is mainly a parts seller with no stated base or project evidence.

license.name: TPH Supply
license.note: The site names no base city or license number. It mentions the San Francisco Bay Area and gives phone 650-438-6683. The name suggests a supplier, possibly not an installer. I found no license, and the CSLB name search needs a reCAPTCHA. Search CSLB by name by hand.

candidates.name: Repcold Distributors
candidates.partition_evidence: The site lists Toilet Partitions as a product category and says customers can get everything from restroom partitions to shower enclosures installed.
red_flags: Mainly shower enclosures, mirrors and closets, with no partition projects or photos shown
Sells partitions itself, which is a buy-around risk
Also has Salinas and Riverside offices
candidates.reason: It supplies and installs restroom partitions from Fremont and serves both homeowners and businesses. Commercial partition jobs aren't shown, so it stays possible.

license.name: Repcold Distributors
license.license_type: California contractor license; aggregator snippet lists C-17, C-61/D-28 and C-61/D-34 (unverified)
license.note: The company site gives a Fremont corporate office and phone (510) 498-8786 but no license number. A search snippet from an aggregator (prelien.co/contractor/repcold-distributors-929392) gives CSLB #929392, Fremont, status clear, expiring 2027-03-31, with D-34 among the classifications. I did not open that page and it is not official. The CSLB lookup is behind a reCAPTCHA, so confirm by hand.

candidates.name: Stumbaugh & Associates, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Calls itself the largest provider of restroom partitions and accessories in California and offers professional installation. Project photos include a hotel.
red_flags: Its Northern California office is in West Sacramento, about 75 miles away, though the office phone has a Bay Area 650 area code
Large partition reseller that sells material-only too, so it is a direct competitor and buy-around risk
HQ is in Burbank
candidates.reason: It installs restroom partitions and its NorCal line uses a Bay Area number. The office is outside 30 miles and it competes with us as a reseller.

license.name: Stumbaugh & Associates, Inc.

candidates.name: Demar Specialties, LLC
candidates.partition_evidence: A Division 10 subcontractor that furnishes and installs toilet partitions. It is an authorized distributor for ASI, Bradley, Scranton and Metpar.
red_flags: Manteca is about 60+ miles from SF
Authorized distributor that offers supply-only, so it is a buy-around risk
No phone or email on the site (form only)
candidates.reason: A real commercial partition installer, but based in Manteca, outside the 30-mile area. It serves Northern and Central California, so it is worth a fallback note.

candidates.name: J D Specialties
candidates.partition_evidence: Specializes in the sales and installation of commercial toilet partitions, bathroom accessories and lockers.
red_flags: Stockton is about 65 miles from SF
Stocking distributor of Bobrick and Hadrian partitions, so it is a buy-around risk
candidates.reason: It installs commercial toilet partitions but is based in Stockton, well outside the area.

candidates.name: Consolidated Partitions, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: None for toilet partitions. Its partitions are folding, operable and wire mesh walls (Kwik-Wall), plus Penco lockers.
red_flags: 'Partitions' means folding and operable walls, not restroom stalls
candidates.reason: A Hayward distributor of lockers and folding/operable wall partitions. Nothing shows toilet partition work.
